Class AbstractTrainingSet<S extends org.uma.jmetal.solution.Solution<?>>

java.lang.Object
org.uma.evolver.meta.trainingset.AbstractTrainingSet<S>
Type Parameters:
S - the solution type
All Implemented Interfaces:
TrainingSet<S>
Direct Known Subclasses:
DTLZ3DTrainingSet, RE3DTrainingSet, RWA3DTrainingSet, WFG2DTrainingSet, ZDTTrainingSet
public abstract class AbstractTrainingSet<S extends org.uma.jmetal.solution.Solution<?>> extends Object implements TrainingSet<S>
Abstract base class for TrainingSet implementations that eliminates boilerplate code.

Subclasses only need to provide the configuration data through constructor parameters, while this class handles the common method implementations.

Reference front paths are composed from a base directory and a list of file names. The default directory is "resources/referenceFronts" and can be changed at any time via setReferenceFrontDirectory(String).

    • AbstractTrainingSet

      protected AbstractTrainingSet(List<org.uma.jmetal.problem.Problem<S>> problemList, List<String> referenceFrontFileNames, List<Integer> evaluationsToOptimize, String name)
      Constructs a training set with the specified configuration. The reference front directory defaults to "resources/referenceFronts".
      Parameters:
      problemList - the list of problems in this training set
      referenceFrontFileNames - the list of reference front file names (without directory)
      evaluationsToOptimize - the list of evaluation budgets per problem
      name - the name identifier for this training set
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if lists have different sizes or are empty
